 10 Nov 2026 Watch the best of the boss against Hull with Bench Cam
 Connor Booth 0
 0
 0
 0
 0
 0
 We made it nine wins from ten Premier League games this season with a 1-0 win over Hull City, and you can see how Mikel Arteta and his coaching staff reacted to the game with Bench Cam. 
 The Tigers were resilient in their defensive efforts, and kept us out for the opening 70 minutes of the game, but Martin Odegaard's second-half strike proved enough to secure three points. 
 Saturday's win, coupled with Manchester City's defeat at Nottingham Forest later the same day, means we go into the international break with a five-point lead at the top of the table over second-place Brighton. 
 Press play on the video at the top of the article to watch the boss react to all the key moments as we maintained our 100% record at Emirates Stadium this season.
